Name: Dairy Sheep
Author: DiamondGrey
Description:
Did you know that sheeps were bred and raised for milk even before cows?
Did you know that a significant percentage of the world's most famous cheeses are made using sheep's milk?
Sheep are mammals. As mammals, they produce milk. Many "Harvest Moon Like" games often gloss over this obvious detail. Or maybe they forget it.

This mod only adds a species of sheep that produces milk, from which cheese can be made. No more, no less. 
I had this project in mind for quite a while (the first unpublished alpha was in BFAV format), but I preferred to keep it simple, because I'm still a beginner.

There is only one species, but I included some recolours using the Alternative Textures mod. If you don't want any recolour, you can delete the appropriate AT folder without consequences.
I also included a patch for Animal Husbandry (Liked Treats are the same as a vanilla sheep). You can delete the AHM folder if you don't need it.
